body: US AI chip startup Tenstorrent closed a $1.5 billion Series E at a $6.2 billion valuation, by far the largest round announced on Monday. Backers include ARK Invest, Fidelity and Morgan Stanley.
Investors keep betting that alternatives to Nvidia's GPUs can win share as AI computing costs climb. Elsewhere, Swiss biotech Nouscom raised €120 million for a cancer-prevention immunotherapy.
dek: The AI chipmaker's Series E values it at $6.2 billion.
title: Tenstorrent raises $1.5 billion to take on Nvidia
why: Big money keeps flowing to Nvidia challengers. If chip costs fall, AI products get cheaper for everyone, including Indian startups that rent computing power.
